name: Farmers First Ag Index v4
description: National ratio of prices farms receive to prices farms pay (USDA NASS indexes, 2011 = 100), scored as a percentile of the 1995-2019 quarters.

ratios.all: COMMODITY TOTALS received / PPITW paid (matches USDA's published ratio within about one point)
ratios.crops: CROP TOTALS received / CROP SECTOR paid
ratios.livestock: LIVESTOCK TOTALS received / ANIMAL SECTOR paid
ratios.dairy: DAIRY PRODUCT TOTALS received / ANIMAL SECTOR paid (the animal-sector cost index includes feeder cattle and replacement cows bought)

score: share of 1995-2019 quarters at or below this quarter's ratio, 0-100

labels.meaning: The label says where the ratio sits against the 1995-2019 quarters, split at their quartiles. It describes prices received against prices paid, not farm income. Show it with "vs 1995-2019".
labels.legacy: Until Oct 2026 the labels were STRESSED (0-40), GUARDED (40-55), FAVORABLE (55-70) and STRONG (70-100). They were never tested and read STRESSED in every quarter from 2020, so they were replaced. The old label is still published as label_legacy.

comparisons: The main comparison is the same quarter a year earlier. Quarter-to-quarter changes are partly seasonal.
real_time: real_time is true only for quarters scored live, from Q2'26 (the v4 launch, Oct 7, 2026) on. Earlier quarters were back-filled; 1995-2019 are also in-sample, ranked against a period that includes later quarters.
quarter_rule: average of 3 months; a quarter is published only when all 3 months of both sides are out

validation.preregistered_in: engine/ffai_v4.py (git commit 163cc4b, before the first validation run)
validation.target: year-over-year change in USDA net farm income (FRED B1448C1A027NBEA) deflated by CPI

T2.target: real market income (NFI minus federal ag subsidies)
real market income (NFI minus federal ag subsidies)

r_95pct_range.how: Fisher z with the effective sample size

validation.tests_run: 6 tests ran (2 candidate scores x 3 tests); 6 passed. All correlation tests stay below 0.05 after a Holm correction for running them together. The error tests (T3) have no p value; with 20 and 10 test years the gap is not tested for significance.
validation.scope: year-over-year changes in the all-farms ratio; the 0-100 score level, the labels and the sector scores were not tested
validation.same_year_only: the relationship is within the same year; it is not a forecast
validation.headline_lock: A and B both passed 3/3; by the pre-registered tie rule A was chosen, and the engine was then set to keep A (HEADLINE_METHOD) so a later run cannot switch it
validation.note: the latest year of net farm income is a USDA forecast and can be revised
validation.not_claimed: no relationship with national farm loan delinquency (r about 0)

limitations: Prices only: yields, volumes and government payments are not in the ratio.

The ratio declined about 1.2 points a year over 1995-2019, consistent with rising yields; scores against 1995-2019 therefore run low in most recent years. LOW means low against that period, not low income.
Scores for 1995-2019 are ranked against the whole period, including later years; they are not what a reader would have seen at the time (real_time is false for them).
The quarterly ratio is seasonal; compare with the same quarter a year earlier.
Prices paid includes household living costs as well as farm inputs.
Interest, cash rent, seed and taxes are updated by USDA once a year; the wage index has not changed since April 2025.
The latest month of prices received is preliminary and is revised the following month.
sources: USDA NASS Quick Stats, Agricultural Prices
fields_stable: Fields in current.json, history.json and history.csv keep their names within v4; new fields may be added. A change in meaning gets a new version number. Version 4.1 (Oct 2026): the label values changed. regime now carries the new label (LOW 0-25, BELOW MIDDLE 25-50, ABOVE MIDDLE 50-75, HIGH 75-100, vs 1995-2019) and equals label; the old value (STRESSED / GUARDED / FAVORABLE / STRONG) is in label_legacy, with its lines in label_legacy_thresholds. to_reach entries use the new lines (25, 50, 75) and carry both label and regime. Added: headline, label, label_vs, ratio_change_vs_year_ago_pct, ratio_change_vs_previous_pct, sector year-ago fields, and label and real_time in history.json and history.csv (as the last two CSV columns). score, ratio and every other field are unchanged.
